sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Samples is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello. Straight to the point. Yes. There is news about new stimulators. They make a person not feel any pain, give them strength. They are being sold somewhere on the shoreline, Sanitar, yes, that's the merchant's name. He sells medicine and stimulants to the local junkies... I mean residents. I need to get this medication. Developing new stimulants is expensive, especially difficult with testing on humans. But here, we can say that testing is already in progress and gives results. Many of my acquaintances will be interested in such results. Please bring me samples of these drugs. Make sure that they are sealed and untouched."

- Hand over the injector
- Find the item in raid: 1 AHF1-M stimulant injector

- Find the item in raid: 1 P22 (Product 22) stimulant injector
- Hand over the injector
- Find the item in raid: 1 L1 (Norepinephrine) stimulant injector

"Good job. I've already received quite a few interesting offers. Something tells me that these meds are somehow related to TerraGroup."

The fastest way to acquire all these stimulants is using the Keycard with a blue marking in The Lab. Alternatively, you could kill Sanitar, although he is not guaranteed to have them.
Alternatively, either the two chalets or the rogue base on Lighthouse have multiple stimulants spawn which require no key.
